# hetznerrobot_server_market_product (Data Source)

Reads one offer of the server market — what `hetznerrobot_server_market_order` can order. Market offers come and go; reading one that is gone fails.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hetznerrobot_server_market_product" "offer" {
  id = 2001002
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (Number) Market product id.

### Read-Only

- `cpu` (String) CPU model.
- `cpu_benchmark` (Number) CPU benchmark value.
- `datacenter` (String) Data center, e.g. `FSN1-DC4`.
- `description` (List of String) Textual description, one line per component.
- `dists` (List of String) Distributions that can be preinstalled.
- `fixed_price` (Boolean) Whether the price is fixed (no further reductions).
- `hdd_count` (Number) Number of drives.
- `hdd_size` (Number) Size of one drive in GB.
- `hdd_text` (String) Drive tags, e.g. `ENT.HDD ECC INIC`.
- `langs` (List of String) Languages of the distributions.
- `memory_size` (Number) Memory in GB.
- `name` (String) Product name, e.g. `SB109`.
- `network_speed` (String) Network speed, e.g. `1 Gbit/s`.
- `next_reduce` (Number) Seconds until the next price reduction.
- `next_reduce_date` (String) Date of the next price reduction.
- `orderable_addons` (Attributes List) Addons that can be ordered with the server, e.g. `primary_ipv4`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--orderable_addons))
- `price` (String) Monthly price without VAT.
- `price_hourly` (String) Hourly price without VAT; null when not billed hourly.
- `price_hourly_vat` (String) Hourly price with VAT; null when not billed hourly.
- `price_setup` (String) One-time setup fee without VAT.
- `price_setup_vat` (String) One-time setup fee with VAT.
- `price_vat` (String) Monthly price with VAT.
- `traffic` (String) Included traffic.

<a id="nestedatt--orderable_addons"></a>
### Nested Schema for `orderable_addons`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) Addon id, as `addons` of the order takes it.
- `max` (Number) Maximum orderable amount.
- `min` (Number) Minimum orderable amount.
- `name` (String) Addon name.
- `prices` (Attributes List) Prices per location. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--orderable_addons--prices))

<a id="nestedatt--orderable_addons--prices"></a>
### Nested Schema for `orderable_addons.prices`

Read-Only:

- `hourly_gross` (String) Hourly price with VAT; null when the product is not billed hourly.
- `hourly_net` (String) Hourly price without VAT; null when the product is not billed hourly.
- `location` (String) Location the price applies to.
- `monthly_gross` (String) Monthly price with VAT.
- `monthly_net` (String) Monthly price without VAT.
- `setup_gross` (String) One-time setup fee with VAT.
- `setup_net` (String) One-time setup fee without VAT.
